user_story: As a guest, I want cancelling an already-cancelled booking to return a clear error so that duplicate cancellations are handled.

positive.title: Cancel a Booking That Is Still Active
steps: Step 1: Log in as a guest with an active booking.
Step 2: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' page.
Step 3: Select an active booking from the list.
Step 4: Click on the 'Cancel Booking' option.
positive.expected_result: The booking status changes to 'Cancelled' and the guest receives confirmation that the cancellation was successful.

negative.title: Attempt to Cancel an Already-Cancelled Booking
steps: Step 1: Log in as a guest with a cancelled booking.
Step 2: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' page.
Step 3: Select the cancelled booking from the list.
Step 4: Click on the 'Cancel Booking' option.
negative.expected_result: An error message stating 'This booking has already been cancelled' is displayed to the guest.

edge.title: Cancel Booking Exactly at the Cutoff Time
steps: Step 1: Log in as a guest with a booking that is about to reach the cancellation cutoff time.
Step 2: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' page.
Step 3: Select the booking nearing cutoff from the list.
Step 4: Click on the 'Cancel Booking' option exactly at the cutoff time.
edge.expected_result: The system processes the cancellation request considering the exact cutoff time, and provides a clear message whether the cancellation was processed or not.
